option.dataset: 最近6个月签约目标完成率

requestSQLContent.sql:
SELECT
	CONCAT(RIGHT(a.yue,2)+0,'月') AS ym,
	IFNULL(b.totalvalue,0) AS donevalue,
	IFNULL(c.targetvalue,0) AS targetvalue,
	IF(IFNULL(c.targetvalue,0)=0,0,ROUND(IFNULL(b.totalvalue,0)*100/IFNULL(c.targetvalue,0),2)) AS rate
FROM (
	SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH),'%Y-%m') AS yue
	UNION ALL
	SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 MONTH),'%Y-%m') AS yue
	UNION ALL 
	SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH),'%Y-%m') AS yue
	UNION ALL
	SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH),'%Y-%m') AS yue
	UNION ALL 
	SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),'%Y-%m') AS yue
	UNION ALL
	SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m') AS yue
) a
LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT
		yue,
		SUM(totalvalue) AS totalvalue
	FROM (
		SELECT
			DATE_FORMAT(signed_data,'%Y-%m') AS yue,
			ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(total,0)/IFNULL(conversion_rate,1)),2) AS totalvalue
		FROM ld_salesorder
		WHERE deleted=0
			AND approvestatus<>'已拒绝'
		GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(signed_data,'%Y-%m')
		UNION ALL
		SELECT
			DATE_FORMAT(due_date,'%Y-%m') AS yue,
			ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(total,0)/IFNULL(conversion_rate,1)),2) AS totalvalue
		FROM ld_servicecontracts
		WHERE deleted=0
			AND approvestatus<>'已拒绝'
		GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(due_date,'%Y-%m')
	) a
	GROUP BY yue
) b ON b.yue=a.yue
LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT
		CONCAT(b.targetyear,'-',LPAD(b.targetmonth,2,0)) AS yue,
		SUM(b.targetvalue) AS targetvalue
	FROM ld_salestarget_basic a
	LEFT JOIN ld_salestarget_info b ON b.targetid=a.targetid
	WHERE a.targetname = 'contractamount'
		AND CONCAT(b.targetyear,'-',LPAD(b.targetmonth,2,0),'-01') BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 5 MONTH),'%Y-%m-01') AND DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01')
	GROUP BY CONCAT(b.targetyear,'-',LPAD(b.targetmonth,2,0))
) c ON c.yue=a.yue

SELECT
	targetvalue,
	totalvalue,
	ROUND(IF(targetvalue=0,0,totalvalue*100/targetvalue),2) AS rate
FROM (
	SELECT
		IFNULL((
			SELECT
				SUM(b.targetvalue) AS targetvalue
			FROM ld_salestarget_basic a
			LEFT JOIN ld_salestarget_info b ON b.targetid=a.targetid
			WHERE a.targetname = 'paymentamount'
				AND b.targetyear=YEAR(NOW())
		),0) AS targetvalue,
		IFNULL((
			SELECT
				ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(total,0)/IFNULL(conversion_rate,1)),2) AS totalvalue
			FROM ld_cashbill
			WHERE deleted=0
				AND approvestatus<>'已拒绝'
				AND YEAR(cashbilldate)=YEAR(NOW())
		),0) AS totalvalue
) a

SELECT
	targetvalue,
	totalvalue,
	ROUND(IF(targetvalue=0,0,totalvalue*100/targetvalue),2) AS rate
FROM (
	SELECT
		IFNULL((
			SELECT
				SUM(b.targetvalue) AS targetvalue
			FROM ld_salestarget_basic a
			LEFT JOIN ld_salestarget_info b ON b.targetid=a.targetid
			WHERE a.targetname = 'contractamount'
				AND b.targetyear=YEAR(NOW())
		),0) AS targetvalue,
		IFNULL((
			SELECT
				SUM(totalvalue) AS totalvalue
			FROM(
				SELECT
					ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(total,0)/IFNULL(conversion_rate,1)),2) AS totalvalue
				FROM ld_salesorder
				WHERE deleted=0
					AND approvestatus<>'已拒绝'
					AND YEAR(signed_data)=YEAR(NOW())
				UNION ALL
				SELECT
					ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(total,0)/IFNULL(conversion_rate,1)),2) AS totalvalue
				FROM ld_servicecontracts
				WHERE deleted=0
					AND approvestatus<>'已拒绝'
					AND YEAR(due_date)=YEAR(NOW())
			) a
		),0) AS totalvalue
) a

SELECT
	bill_state AS bill_state,
	COUNT(1) AS anum
FROM ld_account
WHERE deleted=0
	AND approvestatus<>'已拒绝'
	AND rating = '成交客户'
	AND IFNULL(bill_state,'')<>''
GROUP BY bill_state

SELECT
	a.bill_state,
	a.anum,
	a.snum,
	a.srate
FROM (
	SELECT
		a.bill_state,
		a.anum,
		a.snum,
		CONCAT(ROUND(a.snum*100/a.anum, 2), '%') AS srate
	FROM (
		SELECT
			bill_state AS bill_state,
			COUNT(1) AS anum,
			SUM(IF(rating = '成交客户',1,0)) AS snum
		FROM ld_account
		WHERE deleted=0
			AND approvestatus<>'已拒绝'
			AND IFNULL(bill_state,'')<>''
		GROUP BY bill_state
	) a
	ORDER BY ROUND(a.snum*100/a.anum, 2) DESC,a.snum DESC,a.anum DESC
) a

SELECT
	salesorder_no,
	total,
	signed_data
FROM (
	SELECT
		salesorderid AS order_id,
		salesorder_no AS salesorder_no,
		CONCAT(currency_symbol,FORMAT(total,2)) AS total,
		signed_data
	FROM ld_salesorder
	WHERE deleted=0
		AND approvestatus<>'已拒绝'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		servicecontractsid AS order_id,
		contract_no AS order_no,
		CONCAT(currency_symbol,FORMAT(total,2)) AS total,
		due_date AS signed_data
	FROM ld_servicecontracts
) a
ORDER BY signed_data DESC,order_id DESC 
LIMIT 10

SELECT
	IF(IFNULL(a.real_name,'')<>'',a.real_name,a.last_name) AS last_name,
	IFNULL(b.totalvalue,0) AS totalvalue
FROM ld_users a
LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT
		smownerid,
		ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(total,0)/IFNULL(conversion_rate,1)),2) AS totalvalue
	FROM ld_cashbill
	WHERE deleted=0
		AND approvestatus<>'已拒绝'
		AND cashbilldate BETWEEN DATE_ADD(CURDATE(),INTERVAL -DAY(CURDATE())+1 DAY) AND LAST_DAY(CURDATE()) 
	GROUP BY smownerid
) b ON b.smownerid=a.id
WHERE IFNULL(b.totalvalue,0)>0
ORDER BY IFNULL(totalvalue,0)DESC 
LIMIT 5

SELECT
	IF(IFNULL(a.real_name,'')<>'',a.real_name,a.last_name) AS last_name,
	totalvalue
FROM ld_users a
LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT
		smownerid,
		SUM(totalvalue) AS totalvalue
	FROM (
		SELECT
			smownerid,
			ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(total,0)/IFNULL(conversion_rate,1)),2) AS totalvalue
		FROM ld_salesorder
		WHERE deleted=0
			AND approvestatus<>'已拒绝'
			AND signed_data BETWEEN DATE_ADD(CURDATE(),INTERVAL -DAY(CURDATE())+1 DAY) AND LAST_DAY(CURDATE())
		GROUP BY smownerid
		UNION ALL
		SELECT
			smownerid,
			ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(total,0)/IFNULL(conversion_rate,1)),2) AS totalvalue
		FROM ld_servicecontracts
		WHERE deleted=0
			AND approvestatus<>'已拒绝'
			AND due_date BETWEEN DATE_ADD(CURDATE(),INTERVAL -DAY(CURDATE())+1 DAY) AND LAST_DAY(CURDATE())
		GROUP BY smownerid
	) a
	GROUP BY smownerid
) b ON b.smownerid=a.id
WHERE IFNULL(b.totalvalue,0)>0
ORDER BY IFNULL(totalvalue,0)DESC 
LIMIT 5
